# sphere-gl (v1.5.0)

> Perceptual OKLCH/OKLab and Display-P3 WebGL2 background and 5K wallpaper engine. Zero runtime dependencies. Sleep-first 0% idle GPU (`motion: false` by default). Automatic WCAG >= 4.5:1 `--sphere-ink` and `--sphere-glass` UI tokens.

- Package: `sphere-gl`
- Subpaths: `sphere-gl`, `sphere-gl/react`, `sphere-gl/framer`, `sphere-gl/export`, `sphere-gl/palettes`, `sphere-gl/fallback`, `sphere-gl/studio`
- Studio & Preset Builder: https://denissitnikov.github.io/sphere-gl/
- Repository: https://github.com/denissitnikov/sphere-gl

## Quick Copy-Paste Snippets

### 1. Web Component (`<sphere-gl>`, plain HTML / Astro / Vue / Svelte / Webflow)

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sphere-gl@1.5.0/dist/sphere-gl.min.js" defer></script>

<sphere-gl
  seed="7F3K9A"
  mode="fluted"
  atlas="fintech"
  mood="system"
  grain="1.65"
  light-follow="true"
  style="min-height: 100dvh; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--sphere-ink);"
>
  <section style="background: var(--sphere-glass); border: 1px solid var(--sphere-glass-border); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); padding: 2rem; border-radius: 20px;">
    <h1>Readable by default</h1>
    <p style="color: var(--sphere-ink-muted);">Contrast is verified across a 3x3 hero grid.</p>
  </section>
</sphere-gl>
```

Observed `<sphere-gl>` attributes:
`seed`, `mode`, `style` (shader mode only when non-CSS; prefer `mode`), `mood`, `atlas`, `harmony`, `grain`, `motion`, `light-follow`, `solar`, `hour`, `colors`, `preset`.

### 2. CDN Auto-Mount (`data-sphere-bg`)

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sphere-gl@1.5.0/dist/sphere-gl.min.js" defer></script>
<body data-sphere-bg data-atlas="ocean" data-mode="sphere" data-mood="system"></body>
```

### 3. React & Next.js App Router (Zero-Flash SSR + Client WebGL2)

When `seed`, `atlas`, `colors`, or `url` is passed, `SphereBackground` renders `--sphere-*` tokens and an `in oklab` CSS gradient inline during SSR before WebGL2 hydrates.

```tsx
import { SphereBackground } from 'sphere-gl/react';

export function Hero() {
  return (
    <SphereBackground
      seed="7F3K9A"
      atlas="ocean"
      mode="sphere"
      mood="system"
      gamut="auto"
      focusRect={[0.2, 0.25, 0.8, 0.75]}
      style={{ minHeight: '100dvh', color: 'var(--sphere-ink)' }}
    >
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 680, margin: '0 auto', padding: '6rem 1.5rem' }}>
        <h1>Perceptual wide-gamut backgrounds</h1>
        <p style={{ color: 'var(--sphere-ink-muted)' }}>0% GPU when idle.</p>
      </div>
    </SphereBackground>
  );
}
```

Important React prop rule: pass the shader mode via `mode="sphere"`. Reserve `style={{ ... }}` for `React.CSSProperties`.

Server-only token generation without React wrapper:

```ts
import { getSphereTokensAndCss } from 'sphere-gl/palettes';

const { tokens, cssBackground, theme } = getSphereTokensAndCss({
  seed: '7F3K9A',
  atlas: 'paper',
  mode: 'silk',
  mood: 'light',
});
```

### 4. Tailwind CSS v4 & CSS Color 4 Variables

`sphere-gl` natively parses `#hex`, `oklch(L C H)`, `oklab(L a b)`, `hsl(H S L)`, and percentage/byte `rgb()` without 8-bit quantization.

```css
.hero-surface {
  --sphere-color-1: oklch(0.97 0.012 85);
  --sphere-color-2: oklch(0.64 0.19 254);
  --sphere-color-3: oklch(0.72 0.17 42);
  --sphere-color-4: oklch(0.58 0.21 302);
  --sphere-mode: prism;
  --sphere-gamut: auto;
  color: var(--sphere-ink);
}
```

Call `instance.refreshCssVariables()` if CSS custom properties change at runtime.

### 5. Imperative JS / TypeScript & Subpath Exports

```ts
import { mountSphereBackground } from 'sphere-gl';
import { exportCSS, exportPNG, exportSVG } from 'sphere-gl/export';

const bg = mountSphereBackground('#hero', {
  atlas: 'amber',
  mode: 'fluted',
  mood: 'system',
  gamut: 'auto',
  focusRect: [0.2, 0.3, 0.8, 0.7],
});

// Update visual options without losing the current seed:
bg.regenerate({ mode: 'topo', grain: 0 });

// Roll a fresh random seed with a smooth 540ms GPU morph:
bg.regenerate({ seed: 'random', morph: true });

// Export assets (lazy-loaded or imported from sphere-gl/export):
const css = exportCSS(bg.scene!);
const svg = exportSVG(bg.scene!, { width: 3840, height: 2160 });
const png = await exportPNG(bg.renderer, bg.scene!, { width: 5120, height: 2880, strict: true });
```

### 6. Framer Code Component

```tsx
import SphereGL from 'sphere-gl/framer';
export default SphereGL;
```

## Valid Enum Values

- `mode` (`StyleMode` | `'auto'`):
  `'mesh'`, `'sphere'`, `'silk'`, `'caustic'`, `'fluted'`, `'prism'`, `'topo'`, `'auto'`
- `mood` (`MoodMode`):
  `'system'`, `'any'`, `'light'`, `'split'`, `'dark'`
- `gamut` (`GamutMode`):
  `'auto'` (uses Display-P3 when supported), `'p3'`, `'srgb'`
- `atlas` (`CoreAtlasId` | semantic alias | `'auto'`):
  - Coast & Sky: `'burren-chalk'`, `'skellig-night'`, `'antrim-basalt'`, `'boyne-solstice'`, `'wicklow-amber'`, `'achill-dusk'`, `'dingle-horizon'`, `'connemara-lough'`
  - Emerald Isle: `'dawn-meadow'`, `'moss-stone'`, `'peat-bog'`, `'gorse-hedgerow'`, `'moher-slate'`, `'glen-shade'`, `'oak-canopy'`
- `harmony` (`CoreHarmonyId` | `'auto'`):
  `'alabaster-honey'`, `'porcelain-peach-sage'`, `'morning-lilac-pearl'`, `'solstice-ochre-mist'`, `'cerulean-tangerine'`, `'steel-lavender-amber'`, `'aegean-coral-horizon'`, `'twilight-violet-citrine'`, `'electric-sapphire'`, `'velvet-ember-obsidian'`, `'abyssal-aurora-jade'`, `'nocturne-amethyst-rose'`, `'harmonic-wild'`, `'auto'`

## Semantic Atlas Aliases

LLMs and designers can pass intent names to `atlas`:

- `ocean`, `fintech`, `sapphire`, `navy`, `midnight` -> `skellig-night`
- `amber`, `gold`, `luxury`, `bronze`, `honey` -> `wicklow-amber`
- `forest`, `sage`, `matcha`, `meadow`, `mint` -> `dawn-meadow`
- `paper`, `editorial`, `minimal`, `chalk`, `ivory` -> `burren-chalk`
- `slate`, `obsidian`, `mono`, `charcoal` -> `antrim-basalt`
- `sunset`, `coral`, `horizon`, `peach` -> `dingle-horizon`
- `eclipse`, `solstice` -> `boyne-solstice`
- `lavender`, `twilight`, `violet` -> `achill-dusk`
- `teal`, `lagoon`, `jade` -> `connemara-lough`
- `moss`, `stone`, `granite` -> `moss-stone`
- `peat`, `earth` -> `peat-bog`
- `gorse`, `citrine` -> `gorse-hedgerow`
- `cliff`, `nordic` -> `moher-slate`
- `fern`, `emerald` -> `glen-shade`
- `oak`, `olive` -> `oak-canopy`

## Contrast & Hero Readability Rules

1. Always style foreground text over a `sphere-gl` container with `color: var(--sphere-ink)` and secondary copy with `color: var(--sphere-ink-muted)`.
2. `computeUiTokens()` evaluates an analytical 3x3 OKLab field grid across `[0.2, 0.5, 0.8]^2` (or your custom `focusRect`) and clamps outlier poles so `--sphere-ink` (`#FFFFFF`, `#0F172A`, or `#020617`) maintains WCAG >= 4.5:1 contrast against both the median and worst-quartile hero samples.
3. When placing dense hero copy over a known box, pass `focusRect: [x0, y0, x1, y1]` in normalized `0..1` coordinates (for example `[0.15, 0.25, 0.85, 0.75]`) to attenuate high-chroma or dark poles overlapping the text region.
4. For cards or navigation bars floating over `split` or high-chroma scenes, pair `background: var(--sphere-glass)` and `border: 1px solid var(--sphere-glass-border)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)`.
5. Setting `grain: 0` removes visible film texture while keeping a `+/-0.5 LSB` triangular dither so 8-bit dark gradients stay free of banding.
